title: A Flemish wheat field at harvest time, 1565 (Bruegel's The Harvesters)

wheat-field.name: The wheat field
wheat-field.description: A hillside of ripe wheat above a village, a church and the sea; harvesters work and rest under a pear tree.
wheat-field.look: Pieter Bruegel the Elder's The Harvesters (1565): golden wheat, a pear tree, a hazy bay.
